purpose: Part 2/3 of verified final 30-record item effect batch 031; together these files contain exactly 30 reviewed records from the 30-record checkpoint.

items/cornucopia-needful-365.name: Cornucopia of the Needful [Relic]
items/cornucopia-needful-365.effectSummary: A lawful good, neutral good, or lawful neutral possessor can withdraw one fruit each morning; it vanishes after 24 hours if uneaten, and eating it is a standard action. Roll d% for each fruit: 01-15 apple, heal; 16-30 grape cluster, split into twelve portions and each portion functions as heroes' feast for the individual eater, but only LG/NG/LN characters benefit; 31-45 tangerine, break enchantment on the eater; 46-60 strawberry, spell resistance 25 for 5 rounds; 61-74 cherry, death ward for 12 minutes; 75-89 peach, divine power for 10 rounds; 90-100 lemon, neutralize poison on self for 2 hours. Relic power, requiring worship of Yondalla plus either a sacrificed 6th-level divine spell slot or True Believer and at least 11 HD, increases the daily yield to 1d4+1 independently rolled fruits.

items/dance-masks-of-the-great-mother.name: Dance Masks of the Great Mother
items/dance-masks-of-the-great-mother.effectSummary: These intelligent ritual masks occupy the helmet/headband slot and possess the wearer when donned, normally until the mask's purpose is completed and the exhausted wearer collapses unconscious. Known examples include: Corn Child (Int 12, Wis 18, Cha 16; speech, telepathy, read languages/read magic, darkvision/blindsense/hearing 120 ft., Ego 18; cure moderate wounds 3/day, purify food and drink 3/day, Knowledge (nature) 10 ranks/+11, heroes' feast 1/day, plant growth 3/day; it drives the wearer to enrich crops, purify water, provide a feast, gorge, and bless surrounding fields); Moon Owl (Int 12, Wis 18, Cha 18; speech, telepathy, read languages/read magic, darkvision/blindsense/hearing 120 ft., Ego 23; bless 3/day, cure moderate wounds 3/day, Listen 10 ranks/+14, locate creature 3/day, teleport 2/day, greater shout for 15d6 damage 3/day; special purpose defend the bhukas; it compels the wearer to locate and destroy the nearest hostile creature and teleports back to its village if the wearer dies); Storm Eagle (Int 14, Wis 14, Cha 18; speech, telepathy, read languages/read magic, vision/hearing 120 ft., Ego 18; bless 3/day, Listen 10 ranks/+12, Spot 10 ranks/+12, control weather 1/day, quench 3/day; it drives a frenzied dance to call a mighty rainstorm until the wearer collapses).

items/deck-of-illusions-planar.name: Deck of Illusions, Planar
items/deck-of-illusions-planar.effectSummary: A full deck has 34 single-use cards. Drawing a random card and throwing it to the ground creates a major image of that card's planar creature; the figment lasts until dispelled, stays within 30 feet of where the card landed, otherwise acts as if real, and obeys the drawer. Picking up the card instantly dispels the image; when dispelled, the card becomes blank and cannot be reused. Card results are: A hearts Solar; K hearts Planetar; Q hearts Astral deva; J hearts Ghaele; 10 hearts Avoral; 9 hearts Bralani; 8 hearts Hound archon; 2 hearts Lantern archon; A diamonds Elder fire elemental; K diamonds Greater earth elemental; Q diamonds Huge air elemental; J diamonds Large water elemental; 10 diamonds Medium fire elemental; 9 diamonds Medium earth elemental; 8 diamonds Small air elemental; 2 diamonds Small water elemental; A spades Pit fiend; K spades Horned devil; Q spades Erinyes; J spades Barbed devil; 10 spades Hellcat; 9 spades Chain devil; 8 spades Bearded devil; 2 spades Imp; A clubs Balor; K clubs Marilith; Q clubs Succubus; J clubs Hezrou; 10 clubs Vrock; 9 clubs Babau; 8 clubs Dretch; 2 clubs Quasit; one Joker creates the deck owner's image and the other creates the owner's image with sex reversed. A randomly found deck is complete on d% 11-100; on 01-10 it is missing 1d20 cards and its value is reduced proportionally.

items/dragons-draught.name: Dragon's Draught
items/dragons-draught.effectSummary: A dragon or creature with the dragonblood subtype that drinks a draught gains one use of the listed breath weapon during the next hour as a standard action; drinking another before using the first discards the first effect. Nondragons without the dragonblood subtype gain no benefit. Ten varieties: Brass 60-foot line, 6d6 fire, Reflex DC 23 half; White 30-foot cone, 6d6 cold, DC 23; Black 80-foot line, 12d4 acid, DC 24; Copper 80-foot line, 12d4 acid, DC 24; Bronze 100-foot line, 12d6 electricity, DC 25; Green 50-foot cone, 12d6 acid, DC 25; Blue 100-foot line, 12d8 electricity, DC 25; Silver 50-foot cone, 12d8 cold, DC 25; Gold 50-foot cone, 12d10 fire, DC 26; Red 50-foot cone, 12d10 fire, DC 26.
